# Utilization

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Utilization`](gmeow-Utilization.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Utilization>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A measurement of the ratio of current occupancy to maximum capacity at a location, typically expressed as a ratio (0–1) or percentage. The location is the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md); the result is a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md). Computed by the solver layer (P12) from capacity and occupancy measurements, not asserted directly in the canonical core.

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)
